struct Node {
    int data, open, close;
    Node() : data(0), open(0), close(0) {}
    Node(int data, int open, int close) : data(data), open(open), close(close) {}
};

class SegmentTree {
public:
    int n;
    vector<Node> tree;
    
    SegmentTree(int n) : n(n) {
        int size = 1;
        while (size < n) size <<= 1;
        tree.resize(4 * size);
    }
    
    void build(const vector<Node>& nodes) {
        build(0, 0, n - 1, nodes);
    }
    
    void build(int idx, int l, int r, const vector<Node>& nodes) {
        if (l == r) {
            tree[idx] = nodes[l];
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        build((idx << 1) + 1, l, mid, nodes);
        build((idx << 1) + 2, mid + 1, r, nodes);
        tree[idx] = combine(tree[(idx << 1) + 1], tree[(idx << 1) + 2]);
    }
    
    void update(int pos, const Node& node) {
        update(0, 0, n - 1, pos, node);
    }
    
    void update(int idx, int l, int r, int pos, const Node& node) {
        if (pos < l || r < pos) return;
        if (l == r) {
            tree[idx] = node;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        update((idx << 1) + 1, l, mid, pos, node);
        update((idx << 1) + 2, mid + 1, r, pos, node);
        tree[idx] = combine(tree[(idx << 1) + 1], tree[(idx << 1) + 2]);
    }
    
    Node rangeQuery(int ql, int qr) {
        return rangeQuery(0, 0, n - 1, ql, qr);
    }
    
    Node rangeQuery(int idx, int l, int r, int ql, int qr) {
        if (qr < l || ql > r) return Node();
        if (ql <= l && r <= qr) return tree[idx];
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        return combine(rangeQuery((idx << 1) + 1, l, mid, ql, qr), 
                      rangeQuery((idx << 1) + 2, mid + 1, r, ql, qr));
    }
    
    Node combine(const Node& a, const Node& b) {
        int overlap = min(a.open, b.close);
        return Node(a.data + b.data + 2 * overlap, 
                   a.open + b.open - overlap, 
                   a.close + b.close - overlap);
    }
};

class FastReader {
public:
    string buffer;
    size_t pos;
    
    FastReader() : buffer(""), pos(0) {}
    
    string next() {
        while (buffer.size() <= pos || buffer[pos] == ' ' || buffer[pos] == '\n' || buffer[pos] == '\r') {
            if (getline(cin, buffer)) {
                pos = 0;
            } else {
                return "";
            }
        }
        
        size_t start = pos;
        while (pos < buffer.size() && buffer[pos] != ' ' && buffer[pos] != '\n' && buffer[pos] != '\r') {
            pos++;
        }
        return buffer.substr(start, pos - start);
    }
    
    int nextInt() { return stoi(next()); }
    long long nextLong() { return stoll(next()); }
    double nextDouble() { return stod(next()); }
    string nextLine() {
        string line;
        getline(cin, line);
        return line;
    }
};

ll nC3(int n) {
    if (n < 3) return 0;
    return (ll)n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 6;
}

ll nC2(int n) {
    if (n < 2) return 0;
    return (ll)n * (n - 1) / 2;
}

double computeProbability(int m, int n) {
    ll totalWays = nC3(n);
    double favorable = 0.0;
    favorable += nC3(m);
    favorable += (double)nC2(m) * (n - m);
    favorable += 0.5 * (double)m * nC2(n - m);
    return favorable / totalWays;
}

void solve() {
    int n;
    double target;
    cin >> n >> target;
    
    int lo = 0, hi = n - 1;
    while (lo < hi) {
        int mid = lo + ((hi - lo) >> 1);
        double prob = computeProbability(mid, n);
        if (prob >= target) {
            hi = mid;
        } else {
            lo = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    cout << lo << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int testCases = 1;
    while (testCases-- > 0) {
        solve();
    }
    
    return 0;
}
